claim_checks.claim: A full-text index maps tokens to document occurrences. SQLite Full-Text Search 5 (FTS5) supports phrase and prefix queries and optional indexes for configured token-prefix lengths.
claim_checks.page_says: "By default, FTS5 maintains a single index recording the location of each token instance within the document set." … (detail=column) "Phrase queries are not available."
claim_checks.note: Phrase queries (§3.2), prefix queries (§3.3) and a prefix index created for each configured integer (§4.2) are all on the page. Two gaps: the first sentence defines full-text indexes in general, while the page describes only FTS5's own index (wider scope); and the page says phrase queries are unavailable when detail is column or none, a condition the plain "supports phrase queries" drops. No number, version or MUST-level modal is involved, so WARN.
